mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, notification_type, title, content, reference_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{referenceId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, notification_type AS notificationType, title, content, reference_id AS referenceId, created_at AS createdAt
FROM notification
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
